children: Overview
AI data center firm's Q2 revenue grew 35% yr/yr, driven by blockchain-related initiatives
Other Revenue, mainly blockchain, jumped 647% yr/yr in Q2
Quarterly gross profit rose 44%, aided by higher-margin blockchain revenue
Outlook
Company expects future revenue opportunities from new blockchain products and services
Company says blockchain-related revenue could exceed combined revenue from other businesses
Development and commercialization of new products remain subject to technical and regulatory risks
Result Drivers
BLOCKCHAIN INITIATIVES - Co said blockchain initiatives drove 647% yr/yr increase in Other Revenue in Q2
HIGHER-MARGIN BLOCKCHAIN REVENUE - Co said higher-margin blockchain-related revenue contributed to 44% increase in Q2 gross profit
R&D INVESTMENT - Co said increased research and development expenses reflected investment in AI and blockchain initiatives
